meta.title: Smart Grammar Engine
meta.description: Automatic verb conjugation, noun pluralisation, and grammar bar assistance across Dutch, English, French, and Spanish - all offline.

hero.title: Smart Grammar Engine
hero.description: A context-aware grammar system that automatically conjugates verbs, selects the right auxiliary, handles reflexives, and applies sentence-level transformations in real time, completely offline. Supports Dutch, English, French, and Spanish.

heroScreenshot.label: Smart Grammar Engine - Live Conjugation
heroScreenshot.description: Automatic verb conjugation with color-coded grammar assist

steps.title: Tap symbols
steps.description: Each symbol tap is analysed: is it a pronoun, a noun, a temporal marker, or a verb? The engine identifies the word type automatically.

steps.title: State machine updates
steps.description: A sentence state machine tracks subject, tense, auxiliary chain, and clause boundaries. When context changes, all verbs are reconjugated.

steps.title: Display and speak
steps.description: Sentence-level transformations such as do-support, elision, inversion, and reflexives are applied just before display. The result is a grammatically correct sentence.

examples.title: Four Languages, One Tap
examples.subtitle: The engine applies language-specific rules for each supported language. Here are real examples from the app.

examples.input: ik + wil + gaan + jij + wil + gaan
examples.output: ik wil gaan jij wilt gaan

capabilities.title: What the Engine Handles
capabilities.subtitle: From simple present tense to complex multi-clause constructions, the engine covers the full range of grammar needs.

items.title: Verb Conjugation
items.description: Automatically conjugates verbs based on subject, tense, and language. Handles regular and irregular verbs, modal constructions, and auxiliary-verb chains.

items.title: Perfect Tense
items.description: Detects auxiliary verbs and converts the following verb to its past participle form. Dutch and French select the correct auxiliary automatically.

items.title: Continuous Aspect
items.description: English be + verb constructions produce the correct -ing form and handle spelling rules such as CVC doubling, silent-e drop, and -ie to -ying.

items.title: Modal Verbs
items.description: Recognises modal verbs and forces the following main verb into its infinitive form.

items.title: Multi-Clause Support
items.description: When a second subject pronoun appears mid-sentence, the engine starts a new grammatical clause. Each clause conjugates independently.

items.title: Reflexive Verbs
items.description: Dutch reflexive constructions resolve the correct pronoun form based on subject. The engine adjusts the reflexive automatically.

items.title: Noun Pluralisation
items.description: Long-press any noun to choose singular or plural before adding it to the message. The grammar engine then reconjugates verbs to agree with the new number.

items.title: French Noun Agreement
items.description: Tap plural or feminine control tokens to apply full noun-phrase agreement so articles, adjectives, and nouns update together.

grammarBar.title: Determiner Helper
grammarBar.description: The grammar bar is a horizontal strip of tappable chips that appears in tablet landscape mode. Tap a chip to insert a determiner, possessive, or preposition directly before the last noun in the message, producing natural word order without manual repositioning.
grammarBar.dimming: Gender-aware dimming: when a noun is in the message, incompatible articles and demonstratives are automatically dimmed. Tap 'appel' in Dutch and 'de' lights up while 'het' fades, so grammar knowledge is not required.

groups.name: Articles
groups.examples: de, het, een / the, a / le, la, les / el, la
groups.description: Inserted automatically before the last noun for natural word order.

groups.name: Demonstratives
groups.examples: dit, dat / this, that / ce, cette / este, esta
groups.description: Gender-aware dimming highlights the compatible option for the current noun.

groups.name: Possessives
groups.examples: mijn, jouw / my, your / mon, ma / mi, tu
groups.description: Supports ownership framing across all four supported languages.

groups.name: Prepositions
groups.examples: met, voor / with, for / avec, pour / con, para
groups.description: Adds location, direction, and relation context to any sentence.

secondaryScreenshot.label: Noun Pluralisation
secondaryScreenshot.description: Select singular or plural noun form

assistLevels.title: The Right Amount of Help
assistLevels.subtitle: One setting controls how much grammar assistance is shown. Choose the level that matches the communicator's needs or change it as they grow.

items.behavior: Only articles and demonstratives are shown in the grammar bar. Incompatible tokens are dimmed. Contextual hints appear below the bar to guide word order.
All four grammar groups are visible. Incompatible tokens are dimmed based on noun gender. No additional hints. Best for most daily use.
All four groups are shown with no dimming. Every token is equally visible, giving full control over which grammar cues to present.

offline.title: 100% Offline - No Grammar API Required
offline.description: The entire grammar engine - all four languages, all conjugation tables, and all transformation rules - runs on-device. There are no cloud calls, no latency, and no privacy concerns. Verb exception data is stored locally and loaded into memory for fast lookup. If something goes wrong, the app always returns the original word rather than crashing.
